Dados usados ao conectar uma conta: Data used when you connect an account
No YouTube, pedimos autorização para ide: For YouTube, we request permission to identify the selected channel and upload videos. We store the channel ID and name, along with the authorization credentials protected by Windows. For Facebook, we request permission to list Pages you can manage or create content for and to publish Reels to the Page you select.
O serviço de login do Facebook troca o c: The Facebook sign-in service exchanges the authorization code with Meta and returns the Page list to the app. The session expires after five minutes. Temporary data is protected and automatically removed after delivery or expiration. Windows protects the selected Page’s token on your computer. The sign-in service does not receive video files.
Enviamos diretamente ao destino escolhid: We send the video file, title, description, and settings you review directly to the destination you choose. On YouTube, this includes visibility, whether the video is made for kids, and whether it contains synthetic content. The platform receives and handles the data under its own rules.
O histórico local registra os envios e,: The local history logs uploads and keeps the destination and video link returned by the platform for up to 30 days. You can clear account data sooner. We use account data to connect to the destination and carry out or track the uploads you request.
